findings.title: @andrewdavey6971
findings.snippet:
All in all, the hotel and the suite look good. The ground floor pool looks a little underwhelming, but that rooftop pool looks so much better! 

Now, I'm just hoping Caesars brings more of these aesthetics and amenities to more of their Las Vegas hotels!

findings.snippet: Well, will be staying there in September. Looks unimpressive, hummm? The restaurants almost look like diners, we'll see. And I sure hope one of the pools are adults only. Am looking forward though to our visit there.
